title: Navagraha — the Vedic sūktam (study edition) and ślokas

work.title: Navagraha Sūktam (Taittirīya tradition) and the Navagraha Pīḍāhara Stotram

attribution.traditionalLocation: Navagraha Suktam (Vedic tradition) and Navagraha Peedahara Stotram (Brahmanda Purana)

sources.label: Taittirīya Saṃhitā (pañcāśat and vākya texts) and Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa (Drāviḍa text, muralīdhara, gaṇeśvara), with svara — github.com/vishvAsa/vedAH_yajuH
sources.note: The base texts of the mantras in /navagraha/edition/; every one cut by scripts/prayoga/import.py and proven by scripts/prayoga/check.py, every difference of the second text classified.

sources.label: NavagrahaSuktam.tex, github.com/stotrasamhita/vedamantra-book (mantras/)
sources.note: Witness S: the order of the sūktam and the choice of mantras; the base for the salutations.

sources.label: Sāyaṇa and Bhaṭṭa Bhāskara on the Taittirīya Saṃhitā and Brāhmaṇa, via github.com/vishvAsa/vedAH_yajuH
sources.note: On each verse in its Vedic setting; every Sanskrit quotation in the edition is checked against the named commentary.

sources.label: The Ṛgveda (GRETIL, Aufrecht 1877), via github.com/sanskrit/raw_etexts
sources.note: The parallels, and the base of RV 6.6.7 (the last mantra of Ketu).

sources.label: The Saṃskāraratnamālā (Hiraṇyakeśin prayoga), via github.com/vishvAsa/vedAH_yajuH
sources.note: Compared on the edition’s landing page: another tradition’s graha mantras.

sources.note: Reference document kept in the repository. Its own origin is not recorded.

sources.note: Reference document kept in the repository. Its own origin is not recorded.

translation.note: The English translations and analysis of the study edition were prepared for PaddySpeaks, machine-checked and awaiting review by a Sanskrit scholar. The meanings on the ślokas page were prepared for PaddySpeaks.

verification.method: scripts/prayoga/check.py navagraha (Validate Content): every mantra equals its Taittirīya (or Ṛgveda) source apart from logged corrections; every difference of the second text classified; every padaccheda rejoined by sandhi; every commentator quotation found in that commentator.

recordedText: Navagraha Suktam (Vedic Tradition) + Navagraha Peedahara Stotram (Brahmanda Purana)
statusNote: The study edition (/navagraha/edition/) records its sources mantra by mantra and is machine-checked against them. The ślokas page (/navagraha/) records only the traditional location of its texts; no specific edition is recorded for it.
